children: Zelluna received a NOK 15.6M Research Council of Norway grant to improve TCR-NK manufacturing, increase patient doses per donor and reduce cost per dose. No prior grant comparison was provided.
External funding supports efforts to increase doses per donor and reduce cost per dose; the release gives no comparison with prior funding.

The grant builds on Zelluna's established clinical manufacturing capabilities while its lead candidate is in clinical development. Progress on dose yield and cost per dose, alongside updates from the ongoing ZIMA-101 trial, would provide the next evidence of impact.
